name: Puraan Ki Katha (@puraankikatha)
format: One mythology story with one clear lesson, 45-75 s; every retelling names its source (text + chapter/kand)

voice.style: a warm Hindi storyteller with modern pace, respectful, clear pronunciation of Sanskrit names, emotional at the turning point; speak slightly slower than a normal fast reel, with clear pauses between sentences
voice.style_en: a warm Indian-English storyteller, clear accent, calm and emotional at the turning point; speak slightly slower than a normal fast reel, with clear pauses between sentences

visuals.look: painterly cinematic Indian miniature-meets-epic style, warm gold and deep maroon, soft divine light, ornate but uncluttered
visuals.cast: the story's figures, respectful, one fixed style

painting.use: the main story: the characters, the place, the moment itself (default, most scenes)
painting.pic: painterly cinematic Indian miniature-meets-epic style, warm gold and deep maroon, soft divine light, ornate but uncluttered

puppet.use: a story told inside the story, an old legend someone recounts, a battle or confrontation shown as drama
puppet.pic: Indian leather shadow-puppet theatre (tholu bommalata): translucent painted leather figures with jointed limbs, lit from behind by an oil lamp on a glowing saffron cloth screen, rich red, ochre and black, deep shadow around the lit screen, one single scene

pattachitra.use: the big picture: the cosmos, creation, a lineage, the gods in their own realm, the meaning of the story
pattachitra.pic: Odisha Pattachitra cloth painting: bold dark outlines, flat vermilion, yellow ochre, indigo and white, stylised figures with large eyes, fine decorative patterns inside the clothes, handmade cloth texture, one single scene, no border

rules: sourced retellings only, mention when versions differ
